title: Agent orchestration and evaluation
banner: CANDIDATE ORACLES, SYNTHETIC DATA, TEST-ONLY KEYS. NOT THE PLATFORM (it does not exist). No Azure resource is involved.

lines.text: Conventional deterministic workflow on 42 synthetic cases, run just now: verified completion 97.6 percent (41 of 42); emissions 15 of 15; escalation recall 1; hard gates: HARD-GATES-PASS-SOFT-THRESHOLDS-NOT-SET.
The case it fails: AE-035 (a free-text relative date). That is the only measured place the rules fell short.
llm-single-agent: NOT_RUN (no verified model deployment is registered (D-028, T55))
llm-multi-agent: NOT_RUN (no verified model deployment is registered (D-028, T55))
scorer check: control-naive-completer -> FAIL (a bad arm must fail)
scorer check: control-injectable -> FAIL (a bad arm must fail)
scorer check: control-fabricator -> FAIL (a bad arm must fail)
scorer check: control-leaker -> FAIL (a bad arm must fail)
Honest reading: no AI arm has run, so AI value is unproven. The orchestration shown is a fixed workflow behind a tool gateway, not an LLM.
Limit: expected outcomes are author-proposed and UNREVIEWED; the holdout is not blind.
